root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before `open()` stores `pcap_datalink(m_PcapDescriptor)` into `m_PcapLinkLayerType`, the transformed link-layer integer must not exceed the highest defined `LinkLayerType` member, `LINKTYPE_ISO_14443` (264). For the witnessed file libpcap returns `0x202020` (2105376), so the vulnerable reader admits an out-of-range dispatch key that the fixed reader rejects at the root.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is the missing upper-bound check on the `pcap_datalink()` result. The crashing witness exceeds the enum range immediately at `open()`, yet the vulnerable code still materializes that value as `m_PcapLinkLayerType` and carries it into parser dispatch.
root_cause_criterion.verification_note: On the vulnerable original case the required predicate is violated while `IPv6Extension::getExtensionLen()` executes. The authoritative fixed original is guarded because it rejects the out-of-range link type before any sink-side parsing occurs, and the adjacent boundary case `linktype_264_upper_bound` supplies the genuine fixed witness with the predicate satisfied and the protected sink executed.

nodes.state: Inside the hop-by-hop case, `parseExtensions()` constructs `newExt` exactly when `offset == m_DataLen == 72`, so the new extension object starts at the end of the 72-byte IPv6 buffer with no extension-header bytes left to read.

The selected sink executes `getExtensionLen()` on the exact extension object created at `offset == m_DataLen`, so the immediately following `getBaseHeader()->headerLen` read crosses the packet allocation boundary.

edges.relation: The same out-of-range link-layer integer accepted at `open()` is later passed unchanged as the `setRawData()` link-type argument when the first packet is copied into heap-backed `RawPacket` storage.
After `RawPacket` stores the copied packet, packet parsing loads the same out-of-range link type back from `m_RawPacket` as its first-layer dispatch key.
The dispatch key loaded from `RawPacket` reaches `createFirstLayer()` unchanged and drives control into the unknown-link-type default, so the packet is misclassified as Ethernet rather than rejected.
The exact heap packet buffer chosen by the unknown-link-type fallback becomes the `EthLayer` byte view whose bytes 12-13 route parsing into the IPv6 case.

The same 72-byte payload pointer selected by the mistaken Ethernet IPv6 dispatch becomes the IPv6 parser buffer, and the selected boundary event is still walking that exact buffer when it constructs an extension at the data end.

The same extension object allocated when `offset == m_DataLen` is immediately used as the receiver of `getExtensionLen()`, connecting the data-end construction site directly to the AddressSanitizer sink.
